summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, filed a Form 6-K enclosing an appraisal report on the net book value of TIJO Participações e Investimentos S.A. as of June 10, 2026. The purpose is the merger of TIJO into AXIA, which will be submitted for shareholder approval. The report was prepared by TATICCA and values TIJO's net worth at book value, though no specific price, premium, or terms are disclosed. A board recommendation, advisors, and mechanics are not detailed. This is a non-US acquisition transaction filed under a foreign private issuer report. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and post-merger integration risks.
